t: Handing over more than a moment
a: قُلْ إِنَّ صَلَاتِى وَنُسُكِى وَمَحْيَاىَ وَمَمَاتِى لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُۥ ۖ وَبِذَٰلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
p: Inna ṣalātī wa nusukī wa maḥyāya wa mamātī lillāhi rabbi-l-ʿālamīn, lā sharīka lah…
m: Say, "Indeed, my prayer, my rites of sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allāh, Lord of the worlds. No partner has He. And this I have been commanded, and I am the first [among you] of the Muslims."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
